methodology_note: Real coach-per-edition data researched for the 2026 FIFA World Cup (USA/Mexico/Canada) specifically, extending the Argumental coach-cycle solar-revolution signal backtest to a fifth real past edition -- the most recent and best-documented one. Keyed by team name exactly as it appears in engine.backtest's parsed historical matches (post-alias). Each entry is the coach who actually led the team AT the 2026 tournament and the date/time/venue of THEIR first match in charge of that continuous tenure, including two genuine mid-cycle coaching changes close to or during the tournament (Morocco: Ouahbi replaced Regragui in March 2026; Tunisia: Renard replaced Lamouchi during the tournament itself in June 2026). 3 of the 48 real 2026 participants are deliberately omitted because a genuine kickoff time could not be sourced despite the date/opponent/score/venue being well confirmed.
